meeting.going: Hurdle: good to yielding-yielding in places; chase: yielding-good to yielding in places

races.title: Kilberry Pub & Kitchen Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: CHARISMATIC KID is the one to beat on bumper form, and he may well make a winning start over hurdles. The main danger looks to be Willie Mullins' The Irish Avatar , who was useful in his own right in bumpers. OutofAfrika , Luxor Love and Confidence Within are others to note. CHARISMATIC KID (IRE) THE IRISH AVATAR (IRE) OUTOFAFRIKA (IRE)

races.title: Lisadell Equine Hospital 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: A competitive handicap in which the verdict goes to MINERS BRIDGE , who is seeking the 4-timer after a trio of wins over fences. Magic Day is also respected on the back of her encouraging stable debut, whilst Just For One should benefit from this step back up in trip. MINERS BRIDGE (IRE) MAGIC DAY (IRE) JUST FOR ONE (IRE)

races.title: Hotel Park St. Johann In Tirol Austria Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: SOMMESKY looked sure to win when falling at the last at Punchestown last season and, having been given plenty of time to get over that misfortune, is fancied to make amends despite his lengthy absence. Rightfolksplease has returned better than ever since joining his new yard with back-to-back wins in August and looks the main threat, with both Radiator Springs and Arch Empire also capable of being in the mix. SOMMESKY (IRE) RIGHTFOLKSPLEASE (IRE) RADIATOR SPRINGS (IRE)

races.title: BAR 1 Betting 'Download Our App' For Auction Novice Hurdle (Grade 3)
races.verdict: THINKITDONTJINXIT made an impressive start over hurdles at Galway last month, travelling and jumping well before quickening clear from the home turn, and he is fancied to cope with the step up in grade, with City of Cork feared most after creating a taking impression on his return at Clonmel and hurdling debutant It's Only A Game and recent Gowran scorer The Captain's Word also respected. THINKITDONTJINXIT (IRE) CITY OF CORK (IRE) IT'S ONLY A GAME (FR)

races.title: Railway Bar Lismullen Hurdle (Grade 2)
races.verdict: SLADE STEEL has not progressed as hoped since his 2024 Supreme success, but his return to hurdles when last seen duly sparked a revival and he is fancied to make a winning reappearance. The Yellow Clay is a smart hurdler with a good course record to his name and is feared most, with Feet of A Dancer also very much respected due to her excellent record when fresh. SLADE STEEL (IRE) THE YELLOW CLAY (IRE) FEET OF A DANCER (FR)

races.title: BAR 1 Betting Fortria Chase (Grade 2)
races.verdict: ONLY BY NIGHT boasts an excellent record fresh and, while not at the same level as an on-song Majborough , looks worth chancing against that enigmatic but talented rival in a race where any jumping flaw could prove costly. Solness rates best of the rest. ONLY BY NIGHT (IRE) MAJBOROUGH (FR) SOLNESS (FR)

races.title: Jimmy & Sheila Owens Irish EBF Beginners Chase
races.verdict: This is often a very informative maiden chase and this year's looks no different. MIGHTY PARK was held back by inexperience in the Supreme following his demolition job on his Fairyhouse hurdling debut and looks one to follow over fences this season. He can get his chasing career off to the perfect start, perhaps at the expense of his stablemate Saint Baco , who could well be suited by the drop back in trip on first go over the larger obstacles. Largy Star and Bleu De Vassy also deserve mentions. MIGHTY PARK (IRE) SAINT BACO (FR) LARGY STAR (IRE)

races.title: BAR 1 Betting Best Odds Guaranteed Overnight (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict: A bumper that Gordon Elliott has tended to target over the years and the pick of his trio looks to be £310,000 winning pointer UNCLE PAD , who hammered a rival in his point that has since made an encouraging hurdling debut. Kanzler represents the mighty Willie Mullins and is feared most, with his lengthy absence since winning a point of no real concern given his connections. Airforce Marshal beat a subsequent winner under Rules when landing his point and is also respected. UNCLE PAD (IRE) KANZLER (FR) AIRFORCE MARSHAL (IRE)
